## Execution impact

- [ ] Data access, required metadata, sample-download state, and overlap groups
      were updated when affected.
- [ ] Code version, license, environment, entrypoint, installation, smoke test,
      and grade were updated when affected.
- [ ] Required figures still map to datasets, code modules, source tables, and
      acceptance tests.
- [ ] Recorded P0-P3 priorities match the rule-derived priorities.
- [ ] This change does not silently alter an approved route or claim.

## Scientific and publication checks

- [ ] Biological/statistical units, comparisons, outcomes, validation, and
      claim ceiling remain valid.
- [ ] No outcome leakage, pseudoreplication, or discovery/validation overlap
      was introduced.
- [ ] Publication overlap is dated and classified; any `duplicate` route is
      stopped.
- [ ] Post-result analyses are marked exploratory unless independently validated.
